title: Getting started with JsBarcode
text: default symbology CODE128, accepts ASCII text.

title: Getting started with JsBarcode
text: Pick symbology format. barcode_format_info describes every supported format: characters accepts, length, check digit handled, valid example value. formats linear (1D). 2D codes QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF417 Aztec supported JsBarcode. example column gives value valid format: value valid chosen format produces inline message instead barcode:
code: knitr::kable(barcode_format_info[, c("format", "name", "character_set",                                      "length", "check_digit")]) info <- barcode_format_info[barcode_format_info$format == "ITF14", ] JsBarcode(info$example, format = info$format) JsBarcode("5901234123457", format = "EAN13") JsBarcode("123456789999", format = "UPC") JsBarcode("CODE39 TEXT", format = "CODE39") JsBarcode("not a number", format = "EAN13")

title: Getting started with JsBarcode
text: JsBarcode option can passed ... using JavaScript name:
code: JsBarcode("ABC-123",           bar_width = 3,           bar_height = 60,           line_color = "#1a4f8b",           background = "#eef3fa",           font_size = 16) JsBarcode("NO-TEXT", display_value = FALSE, bar_height = 40) JsBarcode("id-0042", text = "Custom label") JsBarcode("Top text", textPosition = "top", textAlign = "left", font = "serif")

title: Development and CI/CD
text: Releases made scripts/release.sh (also available make release). releases, DESCRIPTION holds development version (X.Y.Z.9000) NEWS.md starts # JsBarcode (development version). Add bullet every user-visible change. script: Preflight: requires branch main, clean working tree, main sync origin/main, authenticated gh, tag exist yet, NEWS.md starts development release header. Versions: sets Version: turns NEWS header # JsBarcode X.Y.Z. Checks: runs make check. error warning stops release. Tag: commits, creates annotated tag vX.Y.Z pushes . GitHub release: runs gh release create, using version’s NEWS section release notes. Publishing release triggers pkgdown.yaml, redeploys site gh-pages. Next cycle: bumps X.Y.Z.9000, adds new development header NEWS.md, commits pushes. script asks confirmation changing anything; pass --yes skip prompt (example make release ARGS=--yes).
code: make release ARGS=--dry-run        # preview every step, change nothing make release                       # release the version in DESCRIPTION make release BUMP=patch            # 0.1.0 -> 0.1.1 (also minor, major, X.Y.Z)

title: Barcode Widgets for R using JsBarcode
Barcode Widgets for R using JsBarcode
text: Supported formats listed barcode_formats: CODE128 (/B/C), EAN-13, EAN-8, EAN-5, EAN-2, UPC-, UPC-E, CODE39, CODE93, CODE93 Full ASCII, ITF, ITF-14, MSI (10/11/1010/1110), Pharmacode Codabar. barcode_format_info describes one (accepted characters, length, check digit, typical use valid example). linear (1D) barcodes supported; QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF417 2D codes . value valid chosen format (e.g. letters EAN-13), widget shows inline error message instead barcode.
code: library(JsBarcode)  JsBarcode("Hello world")                                   # CODE128 (default) JsBarcode("5901234123457", format = "EAN13")               # EAN-13 JsBarcode("123456", bar_height = 40, display_value = FALSE) JsBarcode("ABC-123", line_color = "#1a4f8b", background = "transparent")  # Any other JsBarcode option can be passed with its JavaScript name JsBarcode("Label", textAlign = "left", textPosition = "top", flat = TRUE)

title: Create a barcode widget — JsBarcode
text: value Value encode. Coerced single string. format Barcode symbology, one barcode_formats. See barcode_format_info values format accepts. ... Additional JsBarcode options, passed verbatim using JavaScript (camelCase) names, e.g. textAlign = "left", font = "serif". See https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode/wiki/Options. Arguments ... must named full. bar_width Width pixels single bar. bar_height Height pixels bars. display_value Whether print value barcode. text Text display instead value. NULL shows value. font_size Font size pixels displayed text. line_color Colour bars text. background Background colour. margin Margin pixels around barcode. width, height Size widget container. Must valid CSS unit (like "100%", "400px", "auto") number, coerced string "px" appended. elementId Optional id widget's HTML element.

title: JsBarcode 0.1.0
text: Repository reorganised: package now lives repo root; 2017 scaffolding artefacts moved repo. Bundled JsBarcode updated 3.8.0 3.12.3. minified bundle license vendored (bower source tree). JsBarcode() gains format, bar_width, bar_height, display_value, text, font_size, line_color, background, margin ... JsBarcode option. Arguments format must named. widget now actually renders SVG barcode (2017 scaffold printed value text) shows inline error invalid input. Invalid values detected JsBarcode’s valid callback; JavaScript error shown real message logged console. New barcode_formats constant, Shiny demo app, testthat suite GitHub Actions R CMD check. New barcode_format_info data frame describing every format (characters, length, check digit, typical use, valid example), derived JsBarcode 3.12.3 validation rules. barcode_formats now comes gains CODE93FullASCII. Shiny demo groups formats family shows contextual help plus example value selected format. Makefile document/lint/test/check/install/run/site/update-js targets. lintr configuration (.lintr) GitHub Actions lint workflow; package lint-free. pkgdown documentation site “Getting started” vignette “Development CI/CD” article, deployed gh-pages GitHub Actions. scripts/release.sh (make release) automates tagging GitHub releases.
